## Type of change

## The two hard rules

- [ ] **No verbatim course material.** Nothing pasted from the Partner Academy courses or any gated training material. Concepts are in my own words or cited from public docs.
- [ ] **No real exam questions.** Nothing recalled from an exam I sat. Any Exam Traps rows I added are concept-level distinctions derived from the material, not remembered items.

## Accuracy

- [ ] Every claim traces to public documentation or to a concept already established in this repo
- [ ] No invented mapping: nothing is paired, ranked, or categorised in a way the source material does not support
- [ ] No unverifiable exam facts. No question counts, time limits, passing scores, fees, or domain weightings anywhere in the diff
- [ ] Fast-moving facts are marked with `> **Current practice note:**` and say where to re-check
- [ ] Terminology matches the rest of the repo. If I used a different name for something, I flagged it rather than silently changing it

## Note conventions

<!-- Skip this block for housekeeping-only PRs. -->

- [ ] Seven-part shape intact: title, orientation, body sections, scenario, Cost · Complexity · Risk, Quick Revision, Exam Traps
- [ ] Quick Revision is the last section, with a summary flowchart and a concept-to-one-line table
- [ ] Exam Traps table has 3-6 rows in three columns: `If you see...`, `The trap`, `The right call`
- [ ] Visual-first. Nothing runs more than three sentences without a table, diagram, or code block
- [ ] No paragraphs inside table cells or mermaid nodes. Detail moved down into prose instead of being cut
- [ ] Callouts use the established vocabulary (`The key`, `The trap`, `The lesson`, `Rule of thumb`, `Tip`, `Exam trap`, `Testable distinction`)
- [ ] Voice matches: second person, short sentences, no emojis, no em dashes, no filler openings

## Diagrams and links

- [ ] Every mermaid block parses
- [ ] **Every styled node carries `color:#000`** so text stays legible in dark mode
- [ ] Palette is the established three: yellow for concepts, green for actions, lavender for Cost · Complexity · Risk
- [ ] Every diagram has at least one directional arrow, and earns its space against a plain table
- [ ] Diagram and table are not carrying the same content at full length
- [ ] All relative links resolve and heading anchors are correct
- [ ] Files named `NN-Title-Case.md`, and the module README table is updated to match
